en: The image is a sepia-toned, vintage-style postcard showing a large group of people, mostly men, sitting or squatting on the ground with long sticks or poles and what appear to be bundles or tools. The people are minimally dressed, and the landscape appears arid or sandy. There is Portuguese text printed in red, with 'Catumbella' at the top right and 'Gentio da borracha' at the bottom left.
